snippet.title: Treetopians trailer 2026
snippet.description:
Treetopians is a relaxing city builder where you guide a community that constructs its entire base high up in a giant tree. The game is all about managing resources while making sure your villagers are happy and fostering bonds within the community.

You can Wishlist Treetopians and learn more here:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3967310?utm_source=youtube
